name: Wurmlingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wurmlingen (a black dragon on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Wurmlingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wurmlingen arms — black dragon on yellow
